scripts.web:build: node scripts/build-wordcraft.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/build-wordcraft.mjs --check
scripts.build:frontend-update: tsc -b && vite build --mode frontend-update --outDir dist/frontend-update && node scripts/prepare-frontend-update.mjs
scripts.build:installer: npm.cmd run build:update-runner && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:installer:test: npm.cmd run build:update-runner:test && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --features update-test-keys
scripts.build:installer:core-test: set B6H_TEST_CORE_VERSION=3.0.1&& npm.cmd run build:update-runner:test && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --config src-tauri/tauri.core-test.conf.json --features update-test-keys
scripts.build:installer:offline: npm.cmd run build:update-runner && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --config src-tauri/tauri.offline.conf.json
